about: Mod systems. Each is one behaviour with its config switch, the hooks it reads and the Roblox assets it uses.

rows.description: Roblox-font 'Stage N' banner + Roblox sound when any scout reaches a new height stage
Roblox death sound when a scout falls, passes out or dies
Lighting a campfire shows 'Checkpoint!' with a Roblox sound
Replaces the sky with Roblox's classic skybox when the camera uses a skybox
